items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: He used to call it Ben Mulligan too. Ben Mulligan. He was the manager of that bar on there.

ctx.x: It's Rampart and Perdido, where the Hustlers Saloon was. That was on Perdido and Rampart. He used to call it Ben Mulligan too. Ben Mulligan. He was the manager of that bar on there. But he used to call it the Hustlers, the Hustlers Bar. That's right.
A lot of sporting people hanging out there?
